description: Mark (or unmark, gold=false) Open Label tasks as gold/honeypots. The gold answer comes from the ground-truth or latest annotation; tasks with no usable answer fail individually. Gold tasks are served blind to annotators and score their accuracy. Requires open-label:write scope.

gold.description: Default true (mark). Set false to unmark.

taskIds.description: Task ids to mark or unmark (max 200).

name: open_label_set_gold
